  have h10 : Int.ModEq 11 (10 : ℤ) (-1 : ℤ) := by
    norm_num [Int.ModEq]
  have hb : Int.ModEq 11 b (-1 : ℤ) := h.trans h10
  intro n
  exact hb.pow n

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem bounded_residue_power_mod11 (b : ℤ) (h : Int.ModEq 11 b 10) : ∀ n : ℕ, Int.ModEq 11 (b ^ n) ((-1 : ℤ) ^ n) := by

  exact
    (h.pow n).trans
